rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farm_steps: Set up a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, back up the seed phrase offline, and never reuse your main wallet's address. Cost: under $3 of gas for the first transfer. Time: 10 minutes.
Deposit $150 into the Steakhouse Financial vault with the largest allocation on Base and keep the receipt token untouched. Cost: $150 of capital plus $0.10-0.50 of gas. Time: 15-20 minutes to set up.
If Steakhouse Financial has a governance or signal page, vote or comment on one live proposal from the same wallet. Cost: $0.10-0.50 of gas per transaction. Time: 10 minutes, then weekly.

Make one qualifying action each week from the same wallet — a deposit top-up, a swap, a vote or a small borrow — so your activity spans more than one snapshot date. Cost: about $0.10-0.50 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days. Younger protocols (under 180 days) reward a longer, steadier record than a fast in-and-out. Cost: the $150 stays in the position. Time: 30 days, mostly passive.

Track total spend as you go: capital $150, roughly $15 of gas across the window, plus any deposit or withdrawal fee the interface shows before you sign. Cost: $165 all-in worst case. Time: 2 minutes a week in a spreadsheet.

Watch for reward or points pages Steakhouse Financial itself hosts, and record the dates your actions landed so a future claim can be matched to them. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay anyone to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Before you withdraw, check whether Steakhouse Financial charges an exit fee or unlock period on Base; plan the withdrawal inside that constraint. Cost: $0.10-0.50 for the final transaction. Time: 15 minutes.
Write the wallet address, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, so you can repeat the position later or unwind it cleanly. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Deposit $50 of USDC into ShMonad on Monad and keep the position open through the whole qualifying window. Cost: $50 of capital plus $0.10-1 of gas. Time: 15-20 minutes to set up.
Return weekly and touch the protocol's core action (deposit, swap or vote) from the same wallet. Cost: $0.10-1 of gas per transaction. Time: 10 minutes, then weekly.

Make one qualifying action each week from the same wallet — a deposit top-up, a swap, a vote or a small borrow — so your activity spans more than one snapshot date. Cost: about $0.10-1 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 45 days. Younger protocols (under 180 days) reward a longer, steadier record than a fast in-and-out. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 45 days, mostly passive.

Track total spend as you go: capital $50, roughly $6 of gas across the window, plus any deposit or withdrawal fee the interface shows before you sign. Cost: $56 all-in worst case. Time: 2 minutes a week in a spreadsheet.

Watch for reward or points pages ShMonad itself hosts, and record the dates your actions landed so a future claim can be matched to them. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay anyone to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Before you withdraw, check whether ShMonad charges an exit fee or unlock period on Monad; plan the withdrawal inside that constraint. Cost: $0.10-1 for the final transaction. Time: 15 minutes.
Write the wallet address, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, so you can repeat the position later or unwind it cleanly. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
